# Project instructions

**Project type:** non-code

Set the project type to `code` when this repository contains executable code.
Follow `docs/sop/claude-agent-sop.md` with `docs/sop/codex.md` runtime bindings.
Use `$restart-sop` at session start and `$update-sop` at close.

## Key Documents & Dispatch

| When you need to... | Start at | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Find current work | `Backlog.md` | Read the relevant P-number |
| Follow the session process | `docs/sop/claude-agent-sop.md` | Shared process |
| Use Codex tools | `docs/sop/codex.md` | Runtime bindings |
| Read previous sessions | `docs/RECENT-WORK.md` | Generated index |
| Understand past decisions | `docs/agent-memory/` | Read relevant entries |

## Backlog Management

Backlog.md is the source of truth. Status precedes type. Never remove an item;
mark abandoned work `[WON'T]` with a reason. Follow the SOP's transition rules.
